dedupe_keys.name: clearwater riverine two dimensional water quality transport

description: ClearWater-Riverine is a Python two-dimensional river and floodplain water-quality transport model from the US Army Engineer Research and Development Center. It carries heat and constituents by advection and diffusion on unstructured flow grids and can couple to ClearWater reaction modules. The README specifically reports temperature and nutrient modules connected to HEC-RAS-2D results. Users supply a hydraulic flow solution, grid, constituent conditions and simulation period; outputs are time-varying temperature or concentration fields for the chosen river reach. Geographic coverage, mesh and time step come from that hydraulic run. MIT-licensed source and examples are public, although the README says production installation instructions are still being written and currently points users to developer setup involving sibling repositories. A limitation is that the model assumes vertical homogeneity; stratified reservoirs or deep estuaries need another treatment. It supports water-quality and contaminant propagation studies. The catalogue's model-raven is a separate basin runoff model that could supply boundary flow, but no direct interface was checked. No river model was executed.
inputs: Unstructured hydraulic grid and flow fields
